items.label: EXTENSIVE PLAY DOCTOR SET FOR TODDLERS
items.value: IVENRXIU doctor kit comes with a value kids medical kit that includes a stethoscope, oral mirror, otoscope, thermometer, flashlight, syringes, x-ray film and wallstand, medicine bottles, bandages, markers, nameplate, dress up clothes and non woven storage bag, Provide an immersive role-playing experience for your child!

items.label: REALISTIC ROLE-PLAY EXPERIENCE
items.value: IVENRXIU doctor play set comes with a real stethoscope which can hear the heartbeat and let them feel the beating of life, otoscope, oral mirror, flashlight, thermometer can light up when it is working, syringe can be pressed, thermometer can be changed by toggling the paddles to change the degree, accessories with sound and light function can let kids get a more realistic experience when they are playing!

items.label: EDUCATIONAL AND FUN EDUCATIONAL TOYS
items.value: With IVENRXIU doctor toys, children can reduce anxiety and fear of going to the doctor by increasing their knowledge of body parts and understanding and experiencing the use of different medical tools while playing as doctors and nurses. It not only stimulates their imagination, but also develops their empathy!

items.label: SAFE AND PORTABLE DOCTOR SET
items.value: IVENRXIU toy doctor set is made of high quality and durable materials, after strict safety and durability tests, they are designed for small hands, easy to grip, smooth edges without burrs, no need to worry about children's injuries while playing. Also comes with a large capacity storage bag, which is not only convenient to carry, but also allows children to learn storage and organization

items.label: IDEAL GIFT FOR KIDS
items.value: IVENRXIU pretend doctor kit for toddlers is ideal whether as a gift or a special surprise. The simulated medical tools and realistic doctor costumes are not only perfect props for pretend play, role-play, educational activities and building social skills, but also the brightest presence in birthday, Christmas and Halloween gifts!

items.label: Educational Objective
items.value: Communication Skill, Creative Thinking, Imagination Development, Role Play, Social Skill
